_about: Size-guide cards for the live listings that had none on 28 Oct 2026. Coordinates in callouts are raw pixels of the source photo. 'basis' says where each figure comes from; 'estimate' marks the figures no record states, which want a tape measure on the stock.

cards.title: Baguette Halo Drops
cards.basis: Edition One scale (14 mm disc); the drop is the hero's proportion at that scale (the earlier note said 26 mm).

cards.title: Petite Square Huggies
cards.basis: Edition One scale (about 15 mm across).

cards.title: Pearl Circlet Studs
cards.basis: Performance shoot lock (13 mm stud, 9 mm pearl); the hero's pearl-to-stud ratio agrees.

cards.title: Petite Bow Studs
cards.basis: Edition One scale (about 14 mm wide).

cards.title: Prism Cluster Studs
cards.line: Arc 20 mm long · centre stone 6 mm
cards.basis: Edition One scale (20 mm arc, 6 mm centre stone); the hero's ratio agrees.

cards.title: Verdant Cushion Studs
cards.basis: Performance shoot lock (13 mm, 8 mm stone; Edition One said 12 mm); the hero's ratio agrees.

cards.title: Lilac Papillon Ring
cards.line: Butterfly 18 mm · 24 mm with its outline
cards.basis: Edition One scale (butterfly about 18 mm; the performance note said 20 mm); the outline is the macro's proportion.

cards.title: Molten Panel Bangle
cards.basis: The listing's Width line (approximately 10 mm), from the 26 Oct rigid-bangle work.

cards.title: Watch Link Bangle
cards.basis: The listing's Width line (approximately 10 mm). Its photos are the Molten Panel Bangle's (ADT18 duplicates that listing).

cards.title: Marquise Coil Cuff
cards.line: 14 mm across the two turns · marquise 7 mm
cards.basis: The listing's Width and Stones lines (14 mm, 7 mm).

cards.title: Tile Stone Bangle
cards.basis: The listing's Pattern line (square tiles, approximately 4 mm).

cards.title: Baroque Pearl Lariat
cards.line: Ring 20 mm · drop pearl 15 mm · slides to adjust
cards.basis: The listing's Feature and Drop lines (20 mm ring, 15 mm drop pearl, slider lariat). No chain length is stated, so the card shows none.

cards.title: Heartbead Bracelet
cards.basis: Estimate: about 24 beads of 6 mm (listing) plus the toggle, about 18 cm.

cards.title: Lumière Oval Bracelet
cards.basis: Estimate: the house tennis-bracelet length, as the Aditya bracelets.

cards.title: Clover Chain Bracelet
cards.basis: Estimate: Aditya's photo shows it wrapped round the same velvet display as the 17 cm Watch Link Strap.

cards.title: Clover Station Bracelet
cards.basis: Estimate: as the Clover Chain Bracelet.

cards.title: Open Heart Layered Bracelet
cards.basis: Estimate: as the Clover Chain Bracelet.

cards.title: Heartline Paperclip Necklace
cards.basis: Estimate: its model photo sits it just below the base of the neck; 42 cm is the house's usual single-strand length. Hearts 5 mm from the colour-camps lock.

cards.title: Pearl Legacy Necklace
cards.basis: Estimate: worn at the collarbone. Pearls from the matching YF3925 Baroque Shell Bracelet's card (9–11 mm).

cards.title: Lumière Oval Necklace
cards.line: 40 cm · sits at the base of the neck
cards.basis: Estimate: worn at the base of the throat; the store's other tennis necklaces are 36 and 40 cm.

cards.title: Pearl Heart Layered Necklace
cards.basis: Estimate: the snake chain sits at the base of the neck and the pearl strand on the collarbone. Pearls 7 mm from the 25 Oct size check.

skipped.reason: Its copy describes three graduated bands, but all three photos show a single wide hammered cuff (flagged in docs/research/03-audit-history.md, when it was moved to Draft; it is Active again). A card drawn on those photos would size the wrong piece.
